purpose: Connect persistent state, local feedback control and selective observation, then explain when the program should gather evidence or return control to the planner.
editorial_changes: Lead with the three mechanisms and distinguish the success-rate denominator from the jointly successful cost subset.
Add a bowl-task handoff table with explicit assumptions, stopping conditions and evidence for the next planner decision.
Explain that identical reached flags can accompany different grasp outcomes; forwarding the same flag does not add missing evidence.
Distinguish adding observations inside a cell from handing interpretation or strategy revision to the planner.
Clarify that persistent variables neither refresh their values nor remove already-visible conversation history.
Connect feedback inside a cell with feedback between cells, and add four practical design questions plus two answered acceptance checks.

source.basis: Provided PDF introduction and interface sections, existing fixed-source review, and the article's main comparison, ablations and training behavior tables.
source.interpretation: Handoff examples and design questions are explicitly derived guidance, not an additional measured benchmark or an optimal observation algorithm.

validation.pdf_scope: A4 and Letter; light, dark and warm; 100% and 200% text; scripts enabled and disabled.
validation.semantic_manual_review: Two main-only axe incomplete image-viewer references resolve to the same unique native dialog; opening, Escape and focus restoration passed.
validation.manual_visual_review: Four desktop/mobile screenshots and three rasterized PDF pages covering the new table at 100% and 200%; no clipping or split table rows observed.

scope: Editorial revision with unchanged experiment data and execution code. No model, simulator, training, hardware or new performance measurement was run. The earlier review's native late-print scroll limitation remains applicable.
publication: Verified separately after the main-branch push.
